name: camayoc_dora_change_reviews
description: DORA lead time review step (aegis-rb3): every review of each change merged in the window, with its time and verdict, from aegis:ChangeEvent. The reader takes the first review at or after the change's first green from camayoc_dora_change_steps; a change with no row had no recorded review. Only reviews at or before the merge are lifecycle steps. Graphs are bound up front with VALUES (no per-graph string filter): the current and previous monthly window graphs, plus up to 16 exact staged-backfill graphs. An event older than the previous month is not read; its step reads as none/absent.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change ?reviewedAt ?state WHERE { VALUES ?gm { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?gm { ?m a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "merged" ; aegis:occurredAt ?mergedAt . } FILTER(STR(?mergedAt) >= "{start}" && STR(?mergedAt) < "{end}") VALUES ?gr { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?gr { ?r a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "reviewed" ; aegis:occurredAt ?reviewedAt . OPTIONAL { ?r aegis:reviewState ?state } } FILTER(STR(?reviewedAt) <= STR(?mergedAt)) } ORDER BY ?change ?reviewedAt

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo

params.name: start
params.description: window start, RFC 3339 UTC (inclusive)

params.name: end
params.description: window end, RFC 3339 UTC (exclusive)

params.name: changeNow
params.description: change window graph for the window's end month, e.g. https://camayoc.local/window/change/2026-10

params.name: changePrev
params.description: change window graph for the month before changeNow

params.name: staging1
params.description: an exact reviewed staged-backfill graph (aegis-rb3 B2); unused slots carry an IRI with no data, e.g. urn:quipu:import:staging:none
